blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Luggage re-identification (ReID) is a critical task in video surveillance for forensics, security or border management (suspicious or abandoned luggage recognition), as well as luggage management (lost luggage recovery). It enables the association of observations of the same luggage across disjoint camera views in complex environments such as airports, train stations and border crossing. While existing approaches primarily focus on appearance-based cropped image matching under relatively clean conditions, real-world scenarios are characterized by frequent occlusions, cluttered background and crowded scenes which significantly degrade performance. Yet, strategies leveraging the complementarity of multiple shots and views from different video streams is overlooked. In this paper, we study strategies for an end-to-end pipeline that operates from multiple video streams to detect and re-identify luggage. We evaluate different variants on a benchmark dataset acquired in real-world environments to address the questions of selecting and merging different views and shots of the same luggage as well as training on different environment datasets for an overall ReID performance improvement in practical applications.
blocks.zh: 行李再识别(ReID)是影像监控中的一项关键任务,用于鉴证,安全或边境管理(可疑或被抛弃的行李识别),以及行李管理(丢失的行李回收). 它使得同一行李的观察能够通过在机场、火车站和过境点等复杂环境中的不相干相机观察。 虽然现有方法主要侧重于在相对清洁的条件下以外观为主的收成图像匹配,但现实世界情景的特点是经常被遮住、背景杂乱和场景拥挤,严重降低性能。 然而,利用来自不同视频流的多镜头和观点的互补性的战略被忽略了。 在本文中,我们研究一个从多条视频流运行的端到端管道的战略来检测并重新识别行李. 我们评价在现实世界环境中获得的基准数据集上的不同变体,以解决选择和合并同一行李的不同观点和镜头的问题,以及对不同环境数据集的培训,以便在实际应用中全面改进ReID性能。

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Luggage re-identification (ReID) has emerged as a critical capability in modern video surveillance systems, particularly in large-scale environments such as airports and transportation hubs. Existing approaches typically focus on improving feature extraction or metric learning strategies for ReID, often assuming clean detections and fully visible objects. Yet, practical deployment raises several system-level questions that remain largely unexplored: How many cameras are actually required to achieve reliable luggage ReID? How many observations should be gathered for each tracked instance? Does aggregating all available frames improve robustness, or can noisy detections degrade performance? How should multi-camera information be exploited in asymmetric surveillance setups?
blocks.zh: 行李重新识别(ReID)已成为现代视频监视系统的关键能力,特别是在机场和交通枢纽等大型环境中. 现有方法通常侧重于改进ReID的特征提取或衡量学习战略,通常假定是清洁检测和完全可见的物体。 然而,实际部署提出了几个系统层面的问题,这些问题基本上尚未得到探讨: 需要多少相机才能实现可靠的行李回放? 每个跟踪实例应收集多少观测数据? 综合所有可用的框架是否能提高稳健性,或者噪音检测能降低性能? 如何在不对称的监视设施中利用多相机信息?

blocks.en:
To address these questions, we propose an end-to-end pipeline for luggage ReID across multiple scenes in a realistic asymmetric surveillance setting. The gallery’ scene corresponds to the enrollment stage, where luggage items are observed in a controlled environment, e.g., moving alone on a conveyor belt. In contrast, the query’ scene represents unconstrained surveillance areas, where luggage is carried by people and may be partially occluded, viewed from limited angles, or only intermittently visible. Both scenes include multiple cameras providing complementary viewpoints, enabling the proposed approach to leverage multi-view observations rather than relying on single-frame appearance features. This multi-camera setup helps mitigate occlusions and improves the robustness of cross-scene matching.
Such a framework is particularly relevant for applications including the retrieval of lost or abandoned luggage, the ReID of suspicious bags previously scanned by security systems, and forensic analysis in large transportation hubs. This practical context further motivates the need for robust multi-camera and multi-view ReID approaches capable of operating under realistic surveillance conditions.
blocks.zh:
为了解决这些问题,我们提议在现实的非对称监视环境下,在多处场景中为行李重新ID提供端到端管道. 展馆的场景与进入舞台的场景相对应,在可控制的环境中观察到行李物品,例如在传送带上单独移动. 与此相反,查询的场景代表了不受限制的监视区,其中行李由人携带并可能部分被占用,从有限角度看,或者只是间歇地可见. 两个场景都包括提供互补观点的多相机,使得提议的方法能够利用多相观测,而不是依赖单帧外观特征. 这种多相机的设置有助于减轻被遮住,并改进跨相机相配的稳健性.
这种框架对各种应用特别相关,包括取回丢失或遗弃的行李、安全系统以前扫描过的可疑行李的重新识别以及大型交通枢纽的法证分析。 这一实际背景进一步促使人们需要强有力的多相机和多视重意识方法,能够在现实的监视条件下运作。

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: II-A Object and Luggage Re-Identification
blocks.zh: II-A 对象和行李重新识别

blocks.en:
ReID aims at matching instances of the same object across different camera views in non-overlapping surveillance environments. While person, animal and vehicle ReID [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] have been extensively studied, luggage ReID has received comparatively less attention despite its importance in transportation and security applications [ 4 , 5 , 6 , 7 , 8 ] .
Existing luggage ReID methods [ 4 , 5 , 6 , 7 , 8 ] primarily focus on learning discriminative appearance features from cropped image data. For example, QuadNet [ 4 ] introduces a quadruplet loss to learn multi-view representations that are robust to viewpoint variations. However, these methods typically operate on pre-cropped images and assume relatively clean detections, limiting their applicability in real surveillance scenarios.
blocks.zh:
ReID旨在匹配在非重叠监视环境中不同相机视图中同一对象的相机实例. 虽然对人、动物和车辆的ReID[1、2、3]进行了广泛研究,但行李ReID在运输和安全应用方面的重要性相对较少。 [4、5、6、7、8]
现有的行李回放方法[4,5,6,7,8]主要侧重于从被收割的图像数据中学习歧视性外观特征. 例如,QuadNet [4] 引入了四重奏损失,以学习多视角的表达方式,这些表达方式对于看待差异是强有力的。 然而,这些方法通常在被事先封杀的图像上运作,并假定进行相对干净的检测,从而限制了其在真实监控情景中的可适用性.

blocks.en: II-B Whole ReID Pipelines for Real-World Applications
blocks.zh: II-B 用于实际世界应用的整个再开发管道

blocks.en:
Recent advances in multi-object tracking [ 9 ] have incorporated ReID features to improve identity association over time in the same camera. Tracking-by-detection frameworks such as DeepSORT [ 10 ] and variants [ 11 , 12 ] combine motion cues with appearance embeddings to maintain identity consistency across frames.
More recent unified approaches jointly optimize detection and ReID within a single framework. While these methods [ 13 , 14 ] improve tracking robustness, they are primarily designed for single-camera settings and do not explicitly address cross-scene or multi-camera luggage ReID.
Also,
they often assume relatively continuous object visibility, which is not guaranteed in real-world surveillance environments.
Beyond academic research, several industrial solutions have recently explored AI-based luggage ReID systems for real-world airport operations. For instance, a commercial solution automates the ReID of lost or untagged luggage using multi-view image acquisition and visual matching techniques in airport baggage handling systems [ 15 ] . Yet, unlike our asymmetric scenario, both enrollment and query acquisitions are under controlled environments and luggage is isolated. Such systems further highlight the operational importance of robust luggage ReID pipelines for applications including lost luggage retrieval, baggage tracking, and security investigations.
blocks.zh:
多对象跟踪的近期进展[9]已结合了ReID特性,以随着时间推移而改善身份关联在同一相机上. 跟踪逐一检测的框架,如DeepSORT[10]和变体[11,12]结合了运动提示和外观嵌入来保持跨帧的身份一致性.
最近采用的统一方法在一个单一框架内联合优化检测和再识别。 虽然这些方法[13,14]改进了跟踪稳健性,但它们主要是为单相机设置而设计的,并没有明确地针对跨相机或多相机行李ReID.
还有...
它们往往假定物体的能见度相对持续,这在现实世界的监视环境中得不到保证。
除了学术研究外,最近一些工业解决方案还探索了基于AI的行李ReID系统,用于现实世界的机场业务. 例如,一个商业解决方案利用机场行李装卸系统中的多视图图像获取和可视匹配技术,将丢失或无标记行李的重新ID自动化[15]。 然而,与我们不对称的情况不同,入学和查询都处于受控制的环境中,行李被隔离。 这种系统进一步突出了强有力的行李转运管道对包括失窃行李取回、行李跟踪和安全调查在内的应用程序的业务重要性。

blocks.en: Fig. 1: ReID Pipeline Overview
blocks.zh: 图1:重排管道概况

blocks.en: II-C Occlusion and Multi-View Robust Re-Identification
blocks.zh: II-C 占用和多维强力再识别

blocks.en: Occlusion remains one of the most challenging problems in ReID systems. Existing works have proposed part-based representations [ 16 ] , attention mechanisms [ 17 ] , and temporal modeling strategies [ 18 ] to mitigate the effect of missing or partially visible information. Other approaches specifically target occluded ReID through pose-guided alignment or part discovery strategies [ 19 , 20 ] . However, most of these approaches focus on person ReID and assume relatively structured motion patterns.
blocks.zh: 隐蔽仍然是ReID系统中最具挑战性的问题之一. 现有作品提出了以部分为基础的表述[16],关注机制[17],以及时间建模战略[18]来减轻缺失或部分可见信息的影响. 其他方法具体针对通过姿势引导调整或部分发现策略而未实现的再ID[19,20]. 然而,这些方法大多侧重于个人再识别,并假设相对结构化的运动模式.

blocks.en: Multi-view learning approaches attempt to leverage complementary camera viewpoints to improve robustness [ 21 , 22 , 4 ] . These methods demonstrate that combining information across views can significantly enhance feature discriminability. Yet, they typically rely on synchronized or fully observed multi-view data, and do not consider real asymmetric surveillance scenarios where non-cooperative behaviors may lead to fragmented or incomplete observations.
blocks.zh: 多视角学习方法试图利用相机的互补观点来提高稳健性[21,22,4]. 这些方法表明,将各种观点的信息结合起来,可以大大地加强歧视的特点。 然而,它们通常依赖于同步或完全被观测到的多视图数据,不考虑真正的不对称监视情景,即不合作行为可能导致零散或不完整的观测.

blocks.en: III Method
blocks.zh: 页:1 方法

blocks.en: We consider the problem of luggage ReID across two disjoint scenes with distinct characteristics: a ”query” scene and a ”gallery” scene. Each scene is monitored by multiple cameras providing different viewpoints.
blocks.zh: 我们认为行李重新识别的问题涉及两个具有不同特点的不相连的场景:一出“清凉”场景和一出“垃圾”场景。 每个场景都由多个相机监控,提供不同的观点.

blocks.en: In the gallery scene, luggage is transported on a conveyor belt, resulting in predictable and consistent motion patterns. This controlled setting allows trajectories to be reliably associated across cameras, enabling the extraction of representative observations of each luggage instance. In contrast, the query scene corresponds to a more complex environment where luggage is carried by individuals, leading to irregular motion, partial visibility, and fragmented trajectories that cannot be consistently associated across cameras.
blocks.zh: 在画廊场景中,行李被运输到一个传送带上,从而产生可预见而一致的运动模式. 这种可控的设置可以使轨迹可靠地连通相机,从而能够提取出每个行李实例的代表性观测结果. 相形之下,查询场景对应的是个人携带行李的更复杂的环境,导致不规则地运动,部分能见度和支离破碎的轨迹,无法在相机之间连贯地相接.

blocks.en: Given a luggage instance enrolled in the gallery scene, the objective is to retrieve the corresponding observations in the query scene across realistic surveillance conditions, enabling practical applications such as lost luggage retrieval, suspicious baggage search, or forensic analysis.
blocks.zh: 鉴于在展馆场景中录入的行李实例,目的是在现实的监视条件下取回查询场景中的相应观察,从而能够实际应用,如丢失行李取回、可疑行李取回或法医分析。

blocks.en: III-A Pipeline Overview
blocks.zh: 三-A 管道概况

blocks.en:
We propose a pipeline for luggage ReID across disjoint scenes, explicitly designed to handle the asymmetric characteristics of setup.
An overview of the proposed framework is illustrated in Fig. 1 . The pipeline consists of four main stages:
blocks.zh:
我们提出一个跨断开相接场景的行李重新ID管道,明确用来处理设置的不对称特征.
图1概述了拟议框架。 管道包括四个主要阶段:

blocks.en: III-A 1 Detection and Tracking
blocks.zh: III-A 1 侦测和跟踪

blocks.en: Each video stream is processed independently to detect luggage instances and then associated to form tracks over time. In the gallery scene, the structured motion of luggage allows consistent association of tracks across cameras. In contrast, in the query scene, tracking is performed per camera due to the absence of reliable cross-camera associations.
blocks.zh: 每个视频流都是独立处理的,以检测行李实例,然后链接到一段时间后形成音轨. 在画廊场景中,有条理地运动行李,使得相机交叉的轨迹能够一致地相接. 相形之下,在查询场景中,由于缺乏可靠的跨相机关联,每相机进行跟踪.

blocks.en: III-A 2 Scene-Specific Representation Construction
blocks.zh: III-A 2 特定场景代表建筑

blocks.en:
Due to the asymmetric nature of the considered surveillance setup, several strategies can be considered to construct feature representations for the gallery and query scenes. Depending on the acquisition conditions, a luggage instance may be represented using a single observation, multiple observations from different cameras, or multiple temporal observations extracted from a track.
In controlled environments where trajectories are predictable and objects are consistently observed across viewpoints, multi-camera representations can be constructed by selecting one or several observations per camera. In less constrained surveillance areas, where visibility may be fragmented due to occlusions or unconstrained motion, multiple observations can instead be extracted from a track and combined into a track-level representation.
blocks.zh:
由于所考虑的监视设置的不对称性质,可以考虑采取几种策略来为画廊和查询场景构建出特色表现. 根据获得条件,行李实例可以使用单一观测,不同相机的多观测,或从轨道提取的多时观测来表示.
在可控环境中,轨道是可预测的,物体是连续地横跨视线观测的,可以通过每相机选择一到几个观测点来构建多相机表示. 在不太受限制的监视地区,由于被隔离或运动不受限制,可见度可能支离破碎,相反,可以从一个轨道中提取出多种观测结果,并合并成一个轨道一级的代表。

blocks.en: III-A 3 Feature Extraction
blocks.zh: III-A 3 提取特性

blocks.en: For each detected instance, visual features are extracted using a deep neural network. These features capture appearance cues that should be invariant to viewpoint and illumination changes, and can then be aggregated depending on the multi-shot aggregation strategy.
blocks.zh: 对于每一个被检测出的例子,视觉特征都使用深神经网络来提取. 这些特性捕捉出外观提示,这些提示对视线和发光变化应无动于衷,然后可以根据多镜头聚合策略加以汇总.

blocks.en: III-A 4 Cross-Scene Matching
blocks.zh: III-A 4 场相匹配

blocks.en: Finally, ReID is performed by matching query representations against gallery representations. Each query track is compared to all gallery tracks using a similarity metric, and gallery candidates are ranked accordingly.
blocks.zh: 最后,ReID是通过将查询说明与席说明相匹配来实现的. 每条查询道都使用相似性度量法与所有道道相提并论,道道道考生也相应排名.

blocks.en: This design leverages the complementary strengths of both scenes: structured multi-view information in the gallery and temporal redundancy in the query. As a result, the proposed pipeline effectively mitigates the impact of occlusions and viewpoint variations in realistic surveillance scenarios.
blocks.zh: 这种设计利用了两个场景的互补优势:画廊中的结构化多视图信息和查询中的时间冗余. 因此,拟议的管道有效地减轻了在现实监测情景中隔离和观点差异的影响。

blocks.en: III-B Detection and Multi-Object Tracking
blocks.zh: 三-B 探测和多目标跟踪

blocks.en:
The first stage of the proposed pipeline,
applied independently to each camera stream,
consists of detecting luggage instances and associating them over time to form tracks.
blocks.zh:
拟议管道的第一阶段,
每个相机流独立应用,
包括探测出行李并随时间推移加以连接以形成轨道。

blocks.en: III-B 1 Detection
blocks.zh: 检测

blocks.en:
Luggage instances are detected in each frame using an object detector that provides bounding boxes (BBox) and confidence scores s c s_{c} for each candidate object. Only detections with s c s_{c} above a predefined threshold θ c \theta_{c} are retained to reduce false positives.
Then, the asymmetric tracking strategy reflects realistic surveillance conditions, where controlled environments (e.g., conveyor systems) allow multi-view association, while unconstrained environments lead to fragmented and incomplete tracks. This difference motivates the use of scene-specific representation strategies in the subsequent stages of the pipeline.
blocks.zh:
每个框架都使用一个对象探测器检测出行李事件,该探测器为每个候选对象提供边框(BBox)和置信分数sc s_{c}。 仅保留预设阈值上方的 s c s = c = c 的检测,以减少假阳性。
然后,不对称的跟踪策略反映了现实的监视条件,其中被控制的环境(如传送系统)允许多视图相接,而不受约束的环境则导致轨道支离破碎和不完整. 这种差异促使在管道的后几个阶段采用针对具体地点的表述战略。

blocks.en: III-B 2 Tracking in the Gallery Scene
blocks.zh: 三-B 2 美术馆现场的跟踪

blocks.en: The gallery scene exhibits a well-controlled environment in which luggage moves on a conveyor belt, at a controlled and constant speed. This results in predictable and consistent motion across cameras, free from any obstruction, enabling reliable association of trajectories between different views.
blocks.zh: 美术馆的场景展现出一种控制良好的环境,其中行李以可控和恒定的速度在传送带上移动. 这导致可以预见和始终如一地跨越相机,不受任何阻碍,使不同观点之间的轨迹能够可靠地联系在一起。

blocks.en: Leveraging this property, detections corresponding to the same luggage instance are associated across cameras based on spatio-temporal consistency. This allows the construction of cross-camera tracks, where each luggage instance is observed sequentially by multiple cameras.
blocks.zh: 利用这个属性,与同个行李实例相对应的探测器根据斯皮提奥-时相一致性通过相机连接. 这使得可以构建出跨相机轨迹,每个行李实例由多相机相继观测.

blocks.en: III-B 3 Tracking in the Query Scene
blocks.zh: 三-B 3 查询场的追踪

blocks.en: In contrast, in the query scene, luggage is carried by people, resulting in less predictable motion patterns, frequent occlusions, and partial visibility across cameras. As a consequence, reliable cross-camera association is not feasible.
blocks.zh: 相形之下,在查询场景中,行李由人携带,导致运动模式不可预测,经常被隐蔽,并有部分能见度横跨相机. 因此,可靠的跨相机协会是不可行的。

blocks.en: Tracking is therefore performed independently for each camera using a tracking-by-detection approach, where detections are associated across consecutive frames based on spatial proximity and appearance similarity. This results in a set of per-camera tracks, each corresponding to a sequence of observations of a luggage instance over time. Due to occlusions and missed detections, these tracks may be fragmented.
blocks.zh: 因此,对每台相机采用逐一跟踪的方法独立进行跟踪,根据空间相近性和外观相似性,连续进行探测。 这导致了一组每相机的轨道,每条轨道都对应着随时间推移对行李实例的一系列观察. 由于被隔离和被探测到的缺失,这些轨道可能支离破碎.

blocks.en: III-C Feature Extraction and Aggregation
blocks.zh: 三-C 地物提取和聚合

blocks.en:
Due to the unconstrained nature of the query scene, individual observations of a luggage instance are often affected by occlusions, motion blur, and imperfect detections. As a result, directly aggregating all observations may introduce noise and degrade the quality of the resulting multi-view and multi-shot representation.
For each detected instance, we first extract a visual feature representation using a deep convolutional neural network. More precisely, given a BBox, the corresponding image region is cropped, resized to a fixed resolution, and passed through the network to obtain a feature vector f ∈ ℝ d f\in\mathbb{R}^{d} , where d d is the output dimension of the network.
blocks.zh:
由于查询场景的无约束性质,对行李实例的个别观察往往会受被隔离,运动模糊,检测不完美等影响. 因此,直接汇总所有观测结果可能会产生噪音并降低由此产生的多视图和多镜头表现的质量。
对于每一个被检测到的例子, 我们首先提取一个视觉特征 代表使用深层的神经网络。 更确切地说,给一个BBox,相应的图像区域被裁剪出,被调整为固定的分辨率,然后通过网络得到一个特性矢量 f QQ R d\in\ mathbb{R}^{d},其中dd是网络的输出维度.

blocks.en: To construct robust query representations, we aggregate features at the track level. Given a track τ = x 1 , x 2 , … , x T \tau={x_{1},x_{2},\dots,x_{T}} , where x i x_{i} is the i t ​ h i^{th} detected instance of a track and T T is the number of instances in this track, we first discard unreliable detections based on their confidence scores so that the remaining satisfy s c i ≥ θ c s_{c_{i}}\geq\theta_{c} .

From the remaining observations, we extract feature vectors ( f 1 , f 2 , … , f K ) ({f_{1},f_{2},\dots,f_{K}}) , where K ≤ T K\leq T . The final multi-shot query representation F q F_{q} is then computed as the average of these features: F q = 1 K ​ ∑ i = 1 K f i F_{q}=\frac{1}{K}\sum_{i=1}^{K}f_{i}
blocks.zh: 从剩下的观测中,我们提取特征向量(f 1,f 2,.,f K) ({f_{1},f_{2},\dots,f_{K}}),其中K≤T K\leq T. 最终多镜头的查询表达式 F q F q q q 被计算为这些特征的平均值: F q = 1 K ∑ i = 1 K f i F q }=\ frac{ 1 }{ K }\ sum_{i= 1 }^{ K } f_{i}

blocks.en: This simple aggregation strategy leverages temporal redundancy within trajectories while ensuring that only reliable observations contribute to the final representation. By filtering out low-confidence detections prior to aggregation, the method reduces the impact of occlusions and noise without requiring additional weighting mechanisms.
blocks.zh: 这种简单的汇总战略利用了轨迹中的时间冗余,同时确保只有可靠的观测有助于最终的表述。 通过在聚合前过滤出低自信检测,这种方法可以减少被隔离和噪音的影响而不需要额外的加权机制.

blocks.en: In contrast, the gallery scene provides structured multi-view observations with limited occlusion. Therefore, no temporal aggregation is required, and each gallery instance γ \gamma is composed of one shot from each camera, such as γ = x 1 , x 2 , … , x # ​ G ​ C ​ a ​ m ​ s \gamma=x_{1},x_{2},\dots,x_{\#GCams} , where # ​ G ​ C ​ a ​ m ​ s \#GCams is the number of cameras in the gallery scene and x i x_{i} is the detected instance of the i t ​ h i^{th} gallery camera.

blocks.en: III-D Cross-Scene Matching
blocks.zh: III-D 场相匹配

blocks.en:
The final stage of the pipeline consists of matching query representations against gallery representations to identify corresponding luggage instances across scenes.
Given a query track, we obtain a single aggregated feature vector F q F_{q} using the proposed temporal aggregation strategy. In contrast, each gallery instance is represented by a set of multi-view features ( F g 1 F_{g}^{1} , F g 2 F_{g}^{2} , …, F g # ​ G ​ C ​ a ​ m ​ s F_{g}^{\#GCams} ).
During matching, we compute the distance between the query feature F q F_{q} and each gallery feature independently. This results in a set of distances between the query and all # ​ G ​ C ​ a ​ m ​ s \#GCams gallery features.
All gallery features are then ranked in ascending order of their distance to the query. Since multiple gallery features may correspond to the same luggage ID (by multi-view association), the final ranking at the identity level is obtained by considering the best-ranked occurrence of each ID.
This formulation allows the matching process to naturally exploit complementary viewpoints in the gallery: even if some observations are less informative or affected by occlusions, other views of the same luggage instance can still yield a low distance and lead to correct identification.
blocks.zh:
管道的最后阶段包括将查询说明与展廊说明相匹配,以识别相隔场景的相应行李情况。
鉴于一个查询轨道,我们利用拟议的时间汇总战略获得一个单一的汇总特性向量F q F q q q 。 相形之下,每个画廊实例都由一组多视图特征(Fg 1 F_{g}^{1},Fg 2 F_{g}^{2},.,Fg # G C a m s_{g}^{\#GCams})来代表.
在匹配期间,我们独立计算查询功能F q F_{q 与每个相册功能之间的距离. 这导致了查询和所有 # G 之间的一组距离 (原始内容存档于2018-10-25). C a m s GCams 画廊特写.
所有画廊的功能随后按其与查询距离的起起伏顺序排列. 由于多个画廊特征可能对应同名行李ID(由多视图关联),所以通过考虑每个ID的名次最高的出现来获得身份级别上的最后排名.
这种提法使得配对过程可以自然地利用画廊中的互补观点:即使一些观察信息较少或受到被被隔离的影响,对同一件行李事件的其他观点仍然可以产生较低的距离并导致正确的识别.

blocks.en: IV Experiments
blocks.zh: 四. 试验

blocks.en: IV-A Dataset Construction
blocks.zh: IV-A 数据集建设

blocks.en: To evaluate the proposed approach under realistic surveillance conditions, we construct a multi-camera luggage ReID dataset from video footage from a real airport, in the customs area (cf. Fig. 2 ). The dataset consists of two disjoint scenes, referred to as the gallery and query scenes, each captured by multiple cameras with different viewpoints.
blocks.zh: 为了在现实的监视条件下评价拟议办法,我们在海关区从一个真正的机场的录像中建造了一个多相机行李检索器数据集(见图2)。 数据集由两个脱节场景组成,被称作"画廊"和"查询场景",每个场景被具有不同观点的多相机所捕获.

blocks.en: While the gallery scene captures luggage items moving on a conveyor belt immediately after plane landing, the query scene corresponds to passengers leaving the customs area through a corridor while carrying their luggage
blocks.zh: 展馆场景捕捉飞机降落后立即在传送带上移动的行李物品,而查询场景则对应乘客在携带行李时通过走廊离开海关区域.

blocks.en:
The acquisition system consists of a multi-camera configuration with 5 cameras in the gallery scene and 6 cameras in the query scene. In both environments, cameras are positioned around the area of interest and oriented toward a common region to maximize coverage of luggage instances.
To establish cross-scene correspondences, we manually annotate matching luggage instances between the query and gallery scenes by selecting consistent trajectories.
blocks.zh:
收购系统由多相机配置组成,展厅场景有5个相机,查询场景有6个相机. 在这两种环境中,相机都位于感兴趣的地区周围,面向一个共同区域,以最大限度地覆盖行李事件。
为了建立交叉场景的通信,我们通过选择一致的轨迹,手动对查询和画廊场景之间的行李实例进行注释.

blocks.en: The resulting dataset contains a total of 116 bags, with multiple observations of each luggage instance across different cameras and time steps, naturally including variations in viewpoint, illumination, and partial occlusions. Overall, the dataset contains 579 gallery tracks and 745 query tracks, with approximately 18 images available per track on average. This setup enables the evaluation of multi-view aggregation strategies in realistic conditions.
blocks.zh: 由此产生的数据集共包含116个袋,对不同相机和时间步骤的每个行李箱进行多处观测,自然包括视线、照明和部分隔离的变化。 总体而言,数据集包含579道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道道 这种设置有助于在现实条件下评价多观点汇总战略。

blocks.en: IV-B Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 四-B 执行详情

blocks.en:
Object detection is performed using the CoDETR detector [ 23 ] with publicly available pretrained weights. This object detector was selected for its strong general object detection performance and its ability to handle complex scenes with multiple overlapping objects.For each luggage instance of the gallery scene, one representative frame is selected per camera by choosing the observation where the luggage instance is closest to the center of the field of view, resulting in a fixed set of 5 images (corresponding to the 5 cameras) that form a structured multi-view representation.
For each query track, feature embeddings are extracted and aggregated over time using the proposed aggregation strategy.
For each detected instance, visual features are extracted using the TransReID algorithm [ 24 ] that is pretrained on the large-scale luggage dataset MVB [ 22 ] and fine-tuned on our constructed dataset. Input images are resized to a fixed resolution of 256*256 pixels, and standard data augmentation techniques are applied during training [ 25 , 26 ] .
During inference, each query track is represented by a single aggregated feature vector, while each gallery instance is represented by a set of multi-view features.
Query and gallery representations are compared with Euclidean distance.
blocks.zh:
物体探测使用CoDETR探测器[23]进行,公开的预加载重. 这个物体探测器是因其强一般物体探测性能及其处理多个相重叠物体的复杂场景的能力而被选中的. 对于画廊场景的每个行李实例,通过选择行李实例最接近取景地中心的观察,每相机选择一个代表性框架,从而形成一组固定的5个图像(对应了5个相机),形成结构化多视图代表.
在每个查询轨道上,会利用拟议的汇总战略抽取和汇总特性嵌入。
对于被检测到的每个实例,都使用TransReID算法取出可视特性[24],该算法在大型行李数据集MVB[22]上预加了训练,并在我们构建的数据集上进行了微调. 输入图像被调整为固定分辨率为256*256像素,在培训过程中应用了标准的数据增强技术[25,26].
在推论期间,每个查询道由一个单一的聚合特征向量代表,而每个相册实例则由一组多视图特征代表.
查询和画廊的表示与欧几利得相去相较.

blocks.en: IV-C Results
blocks.zh: 四-C 结果

blocks.en: We evaluate the proposed approach using standard ReID metrics, including cumulative matching characteristics (CMC) at rank-1, rank-5, and rank-10, as well as mean Average Precision (mAP). To provide a comprehensive assessment, we adopt a bidirectional evaluation protocol and report results for both query-to-gallery (Q→G), for the recognition of every query bag, and gallery-to-query (G→Q) matching, for the recall of every gallery bag.
blocks.zh: 我们使用标准ReID指标评价拟议方法,包括第1级、第5级、第10级以及平均精确度的累积匹配特性。 为了提供全面评估,我们通过一个双向评估协议,并报告查询到查询包(QQG),每个查询包的识别,以及画廊到平间(GQQ)的匹配,每个画廊包的召回结果.

blocks.en: To assess the contribution of each component of the pipeline, we compare the proposed method with several configurations. First, we consider a random single-frame baseline, where one observation per track is selected uniformly at random. To ensure stability, results for this baseline are averaged over ten runs. Second, we evaluate a score-based single-frame variant, where the observation with the highest detection confidence is selected for each track. Third, we consider a variant that uses all available observations per track without applying any confidence-based filtering, followed by feature aggregation. Lastly, we show the results of the proposed approach, that is when considering only the K K most confident detections, based on detection scores, and aggregating them. Here K = 5 K=5 , an extensive study on this parameter is presented shortly after.
blocks.zh: 为了评估管道每个组成部分的贡献,我们把拟议方法与几个配置进行比较。 首先,我们考虑一个随机的单一框架基线,即每个轨道一致随机选择一个观测。 为确保稳定,这一基线的结果平均为10次。 第二,我们评价一个基于分数的单帧变体,在每个赛道上选择具有最高探测信心的观测. 第三,我们考虑一种变体,它利用每个轨道的所有现有观测数据,而不采用任何基于信任的过滤,然后进行特征汇总。 最后,我们显示了拟议方法的结果,即只考虑根据检测分数得出的最有信心的K K检测结果,并将其汇总起来。 在此 K = 5 K = 5, 不久后提出了关于这个参数的广泛研究.

blocks.en: TABLE I: Variants comparison results
blocks.zh: 表格 一:可选办法比较结果

blocks.en: As shown in Tab. I , the random single-frame baseline yields the lowest performance, highlighting the limitations of relying on arbitrary observations. Selecting the highest-confidence frame improves results, confirming that detection confidence is a reliable indicator of observation quality even for ReID.
blocks.zh: 如塔布所显示. 我,随机的单帧基线产生的最低性能,突出了依赖任意观察的局限性. 选择最高自信框架可以改善结果,确认探测自信即使是对ReID来说也是观测质量的可靠指标.

blocks.en: Fig. 2: Visualization of a query with ReID ranking
blocks.zh: 发相. 2: 以 ReID 排名可视化查询

blocks.en: Using all frames without filtering further degrades performance compared to the score-based baseline, indicating that low-confidence detections introduce noise into the aggregated representation. In contrast, the proposed approach, which combines confidence-based filtering with feature aggregation, achieves the best performance. This demonstrates that removing unreliable observations prior to aggregation is critical for constructing robust representations.
blocks.zh: 使用所有没有过滤的帧比以分数为基础的基线进一步降解性能,表明低自信检测将噪声引入了总代表. 相比之下,拟议办法将基于信心的过滤与特征汇总相结合,取得了最佳业绩。 这表明,在汇总之前删除不可靠的意见对于建立强有力的表述至关重要。

blocks.en: We observe that the score-based single-frame baseline achieves slightly higher rank-10 performance than the proposed method. This may be because selecting the highest-confidence frame preserves a particularly discriminative observation that still appears among the top-ranked candidates, even if not ranked first. However, the proposed approach consistently outperforms the baseline in rank-1 and mAP, which are more important metrics for practical deployment.
blocks.zh: 我们注意到,基于分数的单帧基线的分级-10性能略高于拟议方法. 这可能是因为选择最高信任框架保留了一种特别有歧视性的观察,这种观察仍然出现在排名最高的候选人中,即使不是排名第一。 然而,拟议办法的绩效始终高于一级和一级军事规划的基线,而后者是实际部署的更重要的衡量标准。

blocks.en: In real-world applications, ReID systems are often integrated into automated pipelines where decisions rely on the top-ranked match rather than a shortlist of candidates. In this context, improving rank-1 accuracy is essential, as it directly impacts the reliability of automatic identification. Similarly, higher mAP reflects better overall ranking quality across all queries. Therefore, despite slightly lower rank-10 performance, the proposed method provides a more robust and practically relevant solution.
blocks.zh: 在现实世界的应用中,ReID系统往往被集成到自动管道中,其中的决定依赖于排名最高的匹配而不是候选人的入围名单. 在这方面,必须提高一级准确性,因为这会直接影响自动识别的可靠性。 同样地,较高的mAP反映了所有查询的总体排名质量较好。 因此,尽管10级业绩略低,但拟议方法提供了更有力、更切合实际的解决办法。

blocks.en: Overall, these results validate the design choices of the proposed pipeline and emphasize the importance of both filtering and aggregation for handling noisy and partially occluded observations in realistic surveillance scenarios.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,这些结果验证了拟议管道的设计选择,并突出了过滤和汇总对于处理在现实的监视情景中噪音和被部分占用的观测的重要性。

blocks.en:
Lastly, all experiments were conducted on a single NVIDIA TITAN RTX GPU.
Inference time of detection and tracking is 6.1s for the synchronized images of one scene’s cameras whereas ReID runtime is 30ms for a single query.
blocks.zh:
最后,所有实验都是在单一的NVIDIA TITAN RTX GPU上进行的。
探测和跟踪的推断时间为一个场景相机的同步图像为6.1s,而ReID运行时间为单次查询的30ms.

blocks.en: IV-D Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 四-D 读取研究

blocks.en: We conduct a series of ablation experiments to evaluate the contribution of each component of the proposed pipeline, including multi-camera configurations, temporal aggregation strategies, and dataset characteristics.
blocks.zh: 我们进行了一系列消化试验,评价拟议管道每个组成部分的贡献,包括多相机配置、时间汇总战略和数据集特征。

blocks.en: IV-D 1 Impact of Multi-Camera Configurations
blocks.zh: IV-D 1 多卡麦拉配置的影响

blocks.en: We first investigate the impact of the number and selection of cameras in both query and gallery scenes. To this end, we evaluate different configurations, including single-camera setups, camera pairs, and the full multi-camera setting.

blocks.en: Results show that performance varies significantly across cameras, indicating that some viewpoints provide more discriminative information than others. Single-camera configurations generally reduce performance due to limited visibility and missed detections. In particular, Tab. II highlights the asymmetric impact of camera setups in query and gallery scenes. Using a single query camera can still provide relatively strong query-to-gallery performance, as some viewpoints remain discriminative, but it noticeably degrades gallery-to-query results because of missed detections and incomplete luggage coverage. blocks.en: On a side note, Tab. III also reveals that when considering all available query cameras, some luggage instances remain undetected. This is primarily due to low detection confidence in challenging situations, such as bags piled together on trolleys, which leads to missed or unreliable detections. This observation accentuates the inherent difficulty of the task and the impact of detection quality on overall ReID performance.
blocks.zh: 侧记上,塔布. 三还显示,在考虑所有可用的查询相机时,一些行李例仍未被发现. 这主要是由于对有挑战性的情况的探测信心较低,例如将袋子堆放在推车上,导致检测缺失或不可靠. 这种观察突出了任务固有的困难和检测质量对整个ReID性能的影响.

blocks.en: These findings highlight the importance of multi-camera setups in realistic surveillance environments, where individual cameras may fail to capture complete object information due to occlusions or limited fields of view.
blocks.zh: 这些发现凸显出多相机设置在现实的监视环境中的重要性,在这种环境下,单个相机可能由于被隔离或视野有限而无法捕捉到完整的物体信息.

blocks.en: IV-D 2 Impact of Temporal Aggregation
blocks.zh: 临时综合效应

blocks.en: We next analyze the effect of temporal aggregation in the query scene. Specifically, we vary the number of observations ( K K -shot) used to construct track-level representations, and compare the impact of having an aggregation or not. We consider different selection strategies, including choosing the top- K K observations based on detection confidence or BBox size.
blocks.zh: 我们接下来分析查询场景中时间聚合的效果. 具体地说,我们改变了用于构建轨迹级表示的观测(K K- shoot)数量,并比较了是否汇总的影响. 我们考虑不同的选择策略,包括根据检测自信或BBox大小选择上-K观测.

blocks.en: TABLE IV: K-shot study
blocks.zh: 表四:K射击研究

blocks.en: When observations are selected according to the detection confidence score, Tab. IV shows that increasing K K without feature aggregation gradually decreases performance, suggesting that lower-quality observations introduce noise. In contrast, feature aggregation consistently improves performance for the same K K , as averaging multiple observations yields more robust descriptors. However, using all available observations significantly increases inference time, highlighting a trade-off between accuracy and computational cost.
blocks.zh: 当根据检测置信分数选择观测结果时,Tab. IV显示,增加K K无特征聚合逐渐会降低性能,说明质量较低的观测会引入噪音. 与此相反,特性汇总不断改善同一K K的性能,因为平均多种观测结果产生更强的描述符。 然而,利用所有现有观测结果,大大地增加了推断时间,突出了准确性和计算成本之间的取舍。

blocks.en:
The same trends are observed when using BBox size as the selection criterion, although performance at low K K is generally lower than with detection confidence. This difference becomes less pronounced for larger K K , where size-based selection can achieve comparable or slightly better results. This suggests that detection confidence is better for selecting a few reliable observations, while size-based selection may retain more complementary appearance information for larger subsets.
Also,
selecting observations based on detection confidence provides a good trade-off between performance and robustness. This validates the design choice of filtering low-confidence detections and averaging the remaining features in our method.
blocks.zh:
在使用BBox大小作为选择标准时也观察到同样的趋势,虽然低KK的性能一般低于有检测信心. 对较大的K K 来说,这种差异变得不那么明显,因为以大小为基础的选择可以取得可比或略好的结果。 这表明检测自信更适合选择几个可靠的观测数据,而以尺寸为基础的选择可能会为较大的子集保留更互补的外观信息.
还有...
选择基于检测信心的观测结果,在性能和稳健性之间提供了良好的取舍. 这验证了过滤低自信检测和平均我们方法所余特征的设计选择.

blocks.en: IV-D 3 Dataset and Domain Analysis
blocks.zh: IV-D 3 数据集和领域分析

blocks.en: We analyze the impact of dataset characteristics and domain adaptation using 3 datasets: a large public dataset (MVB), our primary custom dataset (CD-1), and a second dataset acquired in a different location with a similar setup (CD-2). Both datasets are split for train ( -tr ) and test ( -te ) purposes. We observe that CD-2 appears to be an easier dataset for the ReID task, likely due to its more uniform background (e.g., consistent floor coloring), which reduces visual clutter and may also correlate with more stable lighting conditions and fewer distractors compared to CD-1.
blocks.zh: 我们利用3个数据集来分析数据集特性和域名适应的影响:一个大型公共数据集(MVB),我们的主自定义数据集(CD-1),以及另一个在不同位置获得的具有类似设置(CD-2)的数据集. 两个数据集都用于列车(-tr)和测试(-te)目的被分拆. 我们注意到,CD-2似乎比较容易为ReID任务提供数据集,这可能是因为其背景更为统一(例如,地板颜色一致),减少了视觉杂乱无章,而且与CD-1相比,还可能与更稳定的照明条件和较少的分心器有关。

blocks.en: Fig. 4: Sample of images from each dataset
blocks.zh: 发相. 4: 从每个数据集取出图像样本

blocks.en: We first evaluate on CD-1-te a model pretrained on MVB. The results from Tab. V show limited performance, indicating a significant domain gap between the external dataset and the target environment. Fine-tuning the same model on CD-1-tr leads to substantial improvement, confirming the importance of adapting feature representation to target domain.
blocks.zh: 我们首先在CD -1 -te上评估一个在MVB上预先训练的模型. Tab的结果. V显示的性能有限,表明外部数据集与目标环境之间的重大域间差距. CD-1-tr上的同一种模型的精细调整导致大幅度改进,证实了将特征代表调整到目标域的重要性.

blocks.en: TABLE V: Dataset analysis results
blocks.zh: 表五:数据集分析结果

blocks.en:
We then extend this analysis to CD-2 to evaluate cross-dataset generalization. A model pretrained on MVB and tested directly on CD-2-te again yields relatively low performance, highlighting the difficulty of generalizing across environments. Fine-tuning on CD-1-tr before testing on CD-2-te improves the results, demonstrating partial transferability between datasets with similar acquisition setups. Finally, further fine-tuning on CD-2-tr leads to the best performance, confirming that dataset-specific adaptation remains necessary even when the acquisition conditions are similar.
Overall, these experiments highlight the presence of a domain gap not only between large-scale external datasets and real-world surveillance data, but also between datasets collected in different environments, despite looking very similar (cf. Fig. 4 ). This emphasizes the importance of incremental adaptation when deploying ReID systems in new settings.
blocks.zh:
然后,我们将这一分析扩大到CD-2,以评估跨数据集的概括。 一个在MVB上预先训练并直接在CD-2-te上测试的模型再次产生相对较低的性能,凸显出跨环境通用的难度. 在CD-2-te测试之前对CD-1-tr进行微调,可以改进结果,表明具有类似获取设置的数据集之间的部分可转让性。 最后,对CD-2-tr的进一步微调导致最佳性能,确认即使在获取条件相近的情况下,仍有必要对数据集进行具体调整。
总体而言,这些实验凸显出不仅大规模外部数据集与现实世界监控数据之间存在域间差距,而且在不同环境中收集的数据集之间也存在域间差距,尽管看起来非常相近(参见图4). 这强调了在新环境下部署再分配系统时逐步适应的重要性。

blocks.en: V Conclusion and Future Work
blocks.zh: 五. 结论和今后的工作

blocks.en:
This work focused on studying how detection, tracking, feature selection and aggregation strategies can be combined and adapted in a pipeline for multi-camera luggage ReID in realistic
real-world scenarios and environments.
Through extensive experiments and ablation studies, we analyzed the impact of camera configurations, temporal aggregation, shot selection and dataset adaptation. The results highlight the importance of multi-camera observations and feature aggregation for improving robustness against occlusions and missed detections.
Future work will investigate unsupervised domain adaptation to maintain performance while deploying in new environments without any additional annotation cost.
blocks.zh:
这项工作的重点是研究如何将探测、跟踪、特征选择和汇总战略结合到多相机行李的管道中,并现实地加以调整。
现实世界的情景和环境。
通过广泛的实验和消融研究,我们分析了相机配置的影响、时间聚合、镜头选择和数据集的适应。 研究结果突出了多相机观测和特征汇总对于提高强性来防止被隔离和被漏测的重要性。
今后的工作将调查未经监督的领域适应情况,以保持业绩,同时在新的环境中部署,不增加任何说明费用。
